items.title: SecondBrain VoicePad: Compact AI controls and dictation for your desk
items.excerpt: Genspark's SecondBrain VoicePad pairs five programmable keys with AI dictation and meeting transcription for Mac and PC, recording to onboard memory even when disconnected. It lists at $169, with a Kickstarter launching Nov 24 at $119-$149.

items.title: The vibe-coding revolution is coming to all the gadgets
items.excerpt: Large language models can now redesign your TV interface and upgrade your camera firmware for you; the column asks whether the physical world is ready to be Claude Code-d as LLMs make gadget hacking and modding accessible to everyone.

items.title: Lenovo Pro 9n review: 18-core RTX Spark in a fancy chassis
items.excerpt: Tom's Hardware tests Lenovo's Nvidia RTX Spark laptop, including a local-LLM AgentPerf benchmark against the Surface Laptop Ultra, and finds strong AI hardware but no Windows AI features that make the chip special for non-developers.

items.title: South Korean candidate secretly used AI during professional exams
items.excerpt: A pinhole camera and concealed earpiece let a South Korean candidate pipe exam questions to AI and score 159/160 before turning himself in, amid Korea's wider crackdown on AI smart glasses and hidden devices in exam halls.

items.title: WHOOP users are losing patience with its AI Coach
items.excerpt: WHOOP wearers report the band's AI Coach forgetting context, inventing data and giving contradictory advice, raising questions about how far users can trust LLM coaching layered on health wearables.

items.title: Obsbot's new AI PTZ cameras could make camera operators redundant
items.excerpt: Obsbot's Tail Air 2 and Tail 2 ADV PTZ cameras go on sale with 'AI Tracking 2.0' that follows people, 30+ animal species and 200+ object categories, plus 4K/60p and a 1-inch sensor on the ADV.

items.title: Meta's Muse Charm will reportedly cost $300 and come with free Verizon 5G
items.excerpt: Per The Information, Meta plans to sell its pocket Muse Charm AI agent device for $300 with up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G ahead of the holidays; Meta did not deny it and said it will share more soon.

items.title: Major privacy breaches reported in Muse AI, including bank balances
items.excerpt: Meta employees have flagged what appear to be major privacy breaches in the Muse AI agent, including surfacing bank balances, just as Meta prepares its Muse Charm hardware.

items.title: Gemini app rolls out very slick camera redesign on Android
items.excerpt: Google has thoroughly redesigned the Gemini Android app's in-app camera used to quickly add images to prompts, reworking the capture UI on phones.

items.title: AI agents design an entirely new CPU architecture from scratch, startup claims
items.excerpt: A startup says AI agents designed its Frostbite CPU architecture from scratch, posting 4.59x the performance per watt of an in-order core in pre-silicon tests (3.83x on workloads without AI tuning).

items.title: USC engineers built a smart ring that monitors stress by taking a peek at your sweat glands
items.excerpt: USC engineers built an AI-powered smart ring that uses near-infrared light to detect stress from sweat under the skin, beating gel-based sensors in early tests.

items.title: 스스로 길 찾고 균형까지…산길 달리는 'AI 자전거 로봇'
items.excerpt: 스위스 취리히 연방공대와 RAI 연구소 연구진이 사람 조종 없이 험한 산길을 스스로 달리며 균형을 잡는 AI 자율주행 자전거 로봇을 공개했다.

items.title: The Smart Ring Goes to Church
items.excerpt: From glowing crosses to voice-transcribed prayers, the Elah, Glorify and Blessed rings bring faith rituals to wearables; Blessed calls its S1 'AI-native' with a FaithMate chatbot in its app.

items.title: The Xiaomi 18 Pro proves two screens aren't better than one
items.excerpt: The Verge reviews the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and its rear display, which supports vibe-coded AI mini-apps, concluding the second screen is mostly just for selfies.
